stem: Main Source of Salinity of the Sea is –
expl: The main source of oceanic salinity is land, while rivers are the agents that carry salts to the sea.

stem: The average salinity of the water of the Arabian Sea is-
expl: In the Indian Ocean, between 0°–10° latitudes, salinity ranges from 35–36‰; but in the Bay of Bengal it decreases to about 30‰, whereas in the Arabian Sea salinity is about 36‰. Since 35 ppt (‰) is the nearest option, option (b) is the correct answer.

stem: Which of the following seas has the highest average salinity?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: As per the question, among the given options the Dead Sea has the highest salinity (238‰). Outside the polar regions, the highest salinity at the global level is found in Lake Assal (Djibouti). After that, Turkey’s Lake Van and the Dead Sea occupy the next positions, respectively.

stem: The high tide in the Ocean is caused by
expl: High ocean tides occur due to the resultant force of the Sun’s and Moon’s gravitational attraction and two forces produced on the Earth—centripetal force and centrifugal force. Ocean tides are mainly the result of the Moon’s gravitational pull. The Moon is much closer to the Earth than the Sun. Due to its attraction, sea water rises and forms tides. The gravitational pull of the Sun is not as effective. Therefore, the tides caused by the Sun do not rise as much as those caused by the Moon. It is notable that the tide-generating power of the Moon is about 2.17 times that of the Sun.

stem: The longest river of South America –
expl: The Amazon is the longest river of South America and, in terms of drainage basin area, the world’s largest river.

stem: At the end of its mountainous journey near Attock, the indus river meets which river of Afghanistan?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: The Indus River comes out of the hills near Attock, where the Kabul River coming from Afghanistan joins it on the right bank. The Indus originates near Lake Manasarovar, close to Mount Kailash in Tibet, and flows through Tibet (China), India, and Pakistan finally falling into the Arabian Sea near Karachi.

stem: Which of the following are rivers?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: Murray and Darling are the most prominent rivers of the Australian continent. Their basin is Australia’s most important agricultural region, whereas Erie and Huron are the Great Lakes of the United States and Canada. Similarly, Victoria and Chad are major lakes of the African continent. Suez and Panama are canals.

stem: A river brings its water flowing from a specific region, what is that region called?
expl: The specific area from which a river brings its water is called the catchment area. The area drained by a river and its tributaries is called the drainage basin.
